title: Economía y globalización
goal: Read about remittances as a quietly massive economic force by 2000 -- especially in El Salvador, where they rivaled traditional exports as a source of national income.

items: Describe the role remittances played for El Salvador by the late 1990s.
Explain the relationship between rising emigration and rising remittances.
State roughly how large regional remittances were by 2000, per the IDB.
Use a medida que to describe two things changing together over time.
